basics.summary: PhD researcher at UNIST specializing in Artificial Intelligence applications for remote sensing, Earth observation, and climate.

work.name: National University
highlights: Published 3 multidisciplinary research papers with the Office of the Vice President for Research and Development focusing on applications of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.
Coordinated strategic actions to enhance the research index of National University through faculty research collaborations.
Member, National University Research Council.

work.name: De La Salle University
highlights: Published 4 journal articles and 15 research papers with the DLSU Intelligent Systems Laboratory focused on precision agriculture, business intelligence, and biomedical engineering.

work.name: National University-Asia Pacific College
highlights: Published 6 multidisciplinary research papers focusing on image processing, neural networks, machine learning, and app development.
Subjects handled: Computer Programming, Engineering Mathematics, Engineering Management, Statistics, and Control Systems.
Trained and mentored students for national competitions, won 6 awards from 2018 to 2019.
Best Project, Design Thinking for the Classroom.

work.name: National University
highlights: Co-chair for the Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) Stars Rating committee.
Developed and implemented strategic initiatives that enhanced institutional standards and practices, leading to the achievement of 3 QS Stars rating.
Created strategic plans and actions to establish National University in local and international rankings.
Maintained quality standards, services, and policies across campuses, ensuring compliance with CHEd, ISO, PACUCOA, PTC-ACBET, and PICAB.
Top 1, Outstanding Performance Awardee.
